findings.message: Scope in requires rewording this file's `# purpose:` header line, which says it fills a drifted metadata purpose, to say it fills an empty purpose. The diff changes the fixture to `purpose=""` and refreshes `verified`/`hash`, but line 4 still reads 'Check stage fills a drifted metadata purpose through a scripted model call...'.
findings.paved_road: Change the line 4 `# purpose:` text to say Check fills an empty metadata purpose through a scripted model call and commits the rewrite as a clutch(<stem>): meta commit, then let Check refresh the hash.

findings.message: The diff deletes the existing 'A clean diff must not ask the model again' block (second `check_meta` call asserting no model factory call and no commit). With the new fixture (`owner=""`, stale `relates`), a second Check finds `docs/old.md` no longer drifted. That sends it through generic `meta.refresh`, which rewrites owner to `engine` and drops the stale relation, so the rerun commits. Deleting the assertion hides this break instead of keeping the existing no-model, no-commit-on-clean-diff coverage.
findings.paved_road: Keep the original clean-rerun assertions (`factory.assert_not_called()` and no commit) in a test whose fixture does not depend on preserved empty owner or stale relates. Put the empty-owner and stale-relates preservation check in its own test function so the clean-rerun guard is not removed.
